gloss: lazy person; someone who finds everything bothersome

definitions.gloss: lazy person; someone who finds everything bothersome; person who can't be bothered
definitions.explanation: A person who habitually avoids effort and finds tasks troublesome. Derived from the adjective {面倒|めんどう}くさい with the suffix -がり indicating a personality trait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{面倒|めんどう}くさがりだ。
examples.english: He's a lazy person who can't be bothered with things.

examples.japanese: {面倒|めんどう}くさがりな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧だ。
examples.english: Since I can't be bothered with cooking, I always eat convenience store bento.

examples.japanese: {面倒|めんどう}くさがり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧られる⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me some easy exercises that even a lazy person can keep up with.

notes:
USAGE:
{面倒|めんどう}くさがり is a noun describing a personality type. It is formed from ⟦{面倒|めんどう}くさい→面倒くさい：05308_mendokusai⟧ (bothersome, annoying) + ⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧ (a person who tends to feel a certain way). It is mildly self-deprecating and often used humorously.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can be used as a na-adjective modifier: {面倒|めんどう}くさがりな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person who can't be bothered).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{面倒|めんどう}くさい→面倒くさい：05308_mendokusai⟧ (bothersome — the base adjective)
- ⟦{怠|なま}け{者|もの}→怠け者：16970_namakemono⟧ (lazy person — stronger, more critical)
- ⟦ずぼら→ずぼら：19762_zubora⟧ (sloppy, slovenly — related personality trait)
